item.title: Email Client for the Terminal?
item.summary: Specifically for OpenBSD mailing lists. Is it possible to use just mail(1) for it? I want to use just what is in base. If everything fails... Oh well, besides mutt, any other good email client, if possible simpler? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49340284 Points: 3 # Comments: 2
